# omniddi_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone inside a view. Deleting a zone in OmniDDI also deletes every record in it, so `deletion_protection` defaults to `true` and `force_destroy` is required to delete a zone that still holds records you created. The zone `description` is not supported: the OmniDDI API has no field for it yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_dns_view" "internal" {
  name = "internal"
}

resource "omniddi_dns_zone" "corp" {
  view_id = data.omniddi_dns_view.internal.id
  name    = "corp.example.com"

  ttl     = 3600
  refresh = 900
  email   = "hostmaster@example.com"

  enable_zone_transfer = true

  deletion_protection = false

  tags = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}

resource "omniddi_dns_zone" "reverse" {
  view_id   = data.omniddi_dns_view.internal.id
  zone_type = "Reverse"
  protocol  = "IPv4"
  cidr      = "192.0.2.0/24"

  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "omniddi_dns_zone" "mirror" {
  view_id   = data.omniddi_dns_view.internal.id
  name      = "mirror.example.com"
  zone_type = "Secondary"

  primary_servers = [
    { ip = "198.51.100.10" },
  ]

  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "omniddi_dns_zone" "forward" {
  view_id     = data.omniddi_dns_view.internal.id
  name        = "partner.example.net"
  zone_type   = "Forward"
  nameservers = ["198.51.100.53"]

  deletion_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `view_id` (Number) Id of the view that holds the zone, for example `data.omniddi_dns_view.<name>.id`. Changing it replaces the zone.

### Optional

- `approval_mode` (String) How to behave when OmniDDI requires change approval: `fail` returns an error carrying the request id, `wait` waits until the request is applied. Defaults to the provider `approval_mode`.
- `auto_create_ptr_records` (Boolean) Create PTR records automatically for A and AAAA records.
- `business_unit_ids` (List of Number) Ids of the business units the zone belongs to; the first is the primary one. Defaults to the primary business unit of the calling identity.
- `cidr` (String) Network of a `Reverse` zone, for example `192.0.2.0/24` or `2001:db8::/32`. IPv4 prefixes must be a multiple of 8 from /8 to /32; IPv6 prefixes a multiple of 4. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete the object while true. Set to false and apply before destroying. Defaults to `true`.
- `dynamic_dns_tsig_key_id` (Number) Id of the TSIG key, configured in OmniDDI, used for dynamic DNS.
- `email` (String) SOA contact address of a `Primary` or `Reverse` zone, in the form `hostmaster@example.com`.
- `enable_dnssec` (Boolean) Enable DNSSEC signing. Not possible while the zone holds ANAME records.
- `enable_dynamic_dns` (Boolean) Enable dynamic DNS updates. Requires an allow-update ACL on the view, a zone ACL or a TSIG key.
- `enable_zone_transfer` (Boolean) Allow zone transfers.
- `expiry` (Number) SOA expire time in seconds.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Allow deleting the zone while it still holds records that were not created automatically; OmniDDI deletes them together with the zone. Defaults to `false`.
- `minimum` (Number) SOA minimum (negative caching) TTL in seconds.
- `name` (String) Zone name, for example `corp.example.com`. Compared case-insensitively and without a trailing dot. Optional only for a `Reverse` zone with `protocol` and `cidr`, whose name is then derived. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `nameservers` (List of String) IP addresses of the servers a `Forward` zone forwards to, on port 53; at least one is required for that zone type.
- `network_scope` (String) Network scope: `Internal` (default) or `External`. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `policy` (String) Forward policy of a `Forward` zone.
- `primary_name_server` (String) IP address of the SOA primary name server of a `Primary` or `Reverse` zone.
- `primary_servers` (Attributes List) Primary servers a `Secondary` zone transfers from; at least one is required for that zone type. A server with `tsig_key_id` is contacted with a TSIG-secured transfer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--primary_servers))
- `protocol` (String) IP protocol of a `Reverse` zone: `IPv4` or `IPv6`. Required with `cidr`. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) SOA refresh interval in seconds; at least 300.
- `retry` (Number) SOA retry interval in seconds.
- `secondary_sync_tsig_key_id` (Number) Id of the TSIG key, configured in OmniDDI, used by a `Secondary` zone to sync. Set from the `tsig_key_id` of `primary_servers` when not configured.
- `secure_sync` (Boolean) Use TSIG-secured transfers for a `Secondary` zone.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist. Merged with provider `default_tags`.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued (list) OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `ttl` (Number) Default TTL in seconds.
- `zone_acl_id` (Number) Id of the ACL, configured in OmniDDI, applied to the zone. The API does not return it, so the configured value is kept in state and console changes are not detected.
- `zone_transfer_tsig_key_id` (Number) Id of the TSIG key, configured in OmniDDI, used for zone transfers.
- `zone_type` (String) Zone type: `Primary` (default), `Secondary`, `Forward` or `Reverse`. Changing it replaces the zone.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp reported by OmniDDI.
- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI numeric identifier.
- `records_count` (Number) Number of records in the zone.
- `soa_serial` (Number) Current SOA serial reported by OmniDDI.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All single-valued tags on the object, including those inherited from provider `default_tags`.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp reported by OmniDDI.
- `view_name` (String) Name of the view that holds the zone.

<a id="nestedatt--primary_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `primary_servers`

Required:

- `ip` (String) Primary server IP address.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Primary server port. Defaults to `53`.
- `tsig_key_id` (Number) Id of the TSIG key, configured in OmniDDI, that secures the transfer from this server.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omniddi_dns_zone.corp 34
terraform import omniddi_dns_zone.corp internal/corp.example.com
```
